entries.name: Lying with legs spread
entries.description: On the back, knees bent and thighs open.

entries.name: Legs raised
entries.description: On the back with both legs lifted toward the chest.

entries.name: Bent over
entries.description: Standing with the torso bent forward at the hips, hands braced.

entries.name: Face down, ass up
entries.description: Chest and face down, hips raised high on bent knees.

entries.name: Squatting
entries.description: Crouched low on both feet, knees apart.

entries.name: Kneeling with knees apart
entries.description: Upright on the knees, thighs open, hands free.

entries.name: Lying on the stomach, back arched
entries.description: Face down, hips lifted slightly, back curved.

entries.name: Reclining on the elbows
entries.description: Half lying, propped on both elbows, chest raised.

entries.name: Sitting with legs open
entries.description: Seated, knees apart and leaning back.

entries.name: Standing with one leg raised
entries.description: Standing on one leg, the other lifted and resting on something.

entries.name: Missionary
entries.description: One partner on the back, the other above and facing them, hips together.

entries.name: Legs over the shoulders
entries.description: Missionary with the bottom partner's legs resting on the top partner's shoulders.

entries.name: Folded missionary
entries.description: Missionary with the bottom partner's knees pressed toward their chest.

entries.name: Edge of the bed
entries.description: One lies back at the edge of a bed or table, hips at the edge; the other stands between their legs.

entries.name: Cowgirl
entries.description: One partner on the back; the other straddles their hips, upright and facing them.

entries.name: Reverse cowgirl
entries.description: As cowgirl, but the straddling partner faces away, toward the other's feet.

entries.name: Riding on top, leaning forward
entries.description: Cowgirl with the rider leaning down, chest to chest, kissing distance.

entries.name: Squatting ride
entries.description: The rider squats over the reclining partner's hips, feet planted, bouncing.

entries.name: Reverse squatting ride
entries.description: Squatting ride facing away from the reclining partner.

entries.name: Standing from behind
entries.description: Both standing; the back partner close behind the front partner's hips, often with the front partner leaning on a wall.

entries.name: Bent over from behind
entries.description: The front partner bends over a table or bed edge; the back partner stands behind their hips.

entries.name: Prone from behind
entries.description: The bottom lies flat on the stomach; the top lies over their back, hips together.

entries.name: Face down from behind
entries.description: Front partner face down with hips raised; the other kneels behind them.

entries.name: Spooning from behind
entries.description: Both on their sides facing the same way, the back partner's hips against the front partner's.

entries.name: Side by side, facing
entries.description: Both lying on their sides face to face, legs intertwined.

entries.name: Lotus
entries.description: One sits cross-legged; the other sits in their lap facing them, legs wrapped around their waist.

entries.name: Seated facing away
entries.description: One sits; the other sits in their lap facing the same way, back to chest.

entries.name: Riding on a chair
entries.description: One sits on a chair; the other straddles their lap facing them.

entries.name: Against the wall
entries.description: Standing face to face, one partner's back against a wall.

entries.name: Standing carry
entries.description: One stands holding the other up, their legs wrapped around the carrier's waist.

entries.name: Wheelbarrow
entries.description: The front partner on their hands with legs held up by the standing partner behind.

entries.name: Piledriver
entries.description: Bottom on the shoulders with hips raised overhead; the top squats above them.

entries.name: Amazon
entries.description: The bottom lies back with knees raised; the top kneels astride and takes control from above.

entries.name: Kneeling face to face
entries.description: Both upright on their knees, facing, hips pressed together.

entries.name: Kneeling from behind, upright
entries.description: Both kneel upright, the back partner pressed behind the front partner.

entries.name: Over the arm of the sofa
entries.description: The front partner lies over a sofa arm, hips raised; the other stands behind.

entries.name: Lying back on the table
entries.description: One lies back on a table; the other stands at its edge between their legs.

entries.name: Standing in the shower
entries.description: Standing close under running water, one partner against the tiles.

entries.name: Grinding in the lap
entries.description: One sits; the other sits across their lap, hips moving against them.

entries.name: Sixty-nine
entries.description: Head to toe, one lying on the back and the other face down on top; each mouth at the other's hips.

entries.name: Side sixty-nine
entries.description: Sixty-nine with both lying on their sides, head to hips.

entries.name: Kneeling in front
entries.description: One kneels in front of the other, who stands; face at hip height.

entries.name: Head between the thighs
entries.description: One lies back with legs open; the other lies on the stomach between their thighs.

entries.name: Kneeling before the seated partner
entries.description: One sits on the edge of a seat; the other kneels between their knees.

entries.name: Standing sixty-nine
entries.description: One stands holding the other upside down against them, mouths at each other's hips.

entries.name: Spitroast
entries.description: One on all fours between two partners: one kneeling at their head, one behind their hips.

entries.name: Standing spitroast
entries.description: One bent over between two standing partners, one at each end.

entries.name: Sandwiched between two
entries.description: One partner between two others, chest to one and back to the other.

entries.name: Standing sandwich
entries.description: Three standing pressed together, the middle partner between the other two.

entries.name: Daisy chain
entries.description: Three or more lying in a ring, each mouth at the next partner's hips.

entries.name: Line of partners from behind
entries.description: Three or more in a line on their knees, each behind the next partner's hips.

entries.name: Centre of attention
entries.description: One partner in the middle, the others around them within reach.

entries.name: Line of kneelers
entries.description: Several kneel side by side facing one standing partner.

entries.name: Two on one
entries.description: One lies back on the bed, a partner kneeling on each side.

entries.name: Stacked threesome
entries.description: Two partners lie one above the other; the third kneels behind them.

entries.name: Bed full of bodies
entries.description: Four or more tangled together across one bed.

entries.name: Oral triangle
entries.description: Three lying in a triangle, each mouth at the next partner's hips.

entries.name: Seated with a kneeler
entries.description: One sits with another in their lap; a third kneels in front of them.
aliases: one in the lap one kneeling

entries.name: Kneeling at the bed edge, from behind
entries.description: The front partner on all fours at the edge of the bed; the other stands behind.

entries.name: Legs wrapped around the waist
entries.description: Missionary with the bottom partner's legs locked around the top partner's waist.

entries.name: Side saddle
entries.description: The rider sits sideways across the reclining partner's hips.

entries.name: Flatiron
entries.description: The front partner lies flat with hips on a pillow; the other kneels astride their thighs.

entries.name: Kneeling ride
entries.description: One sits back on their heels on the bed; the other kneels astride their lap.

entries.name: Seated scissors
entries.description: Both sitting facing each other, legs interlocked, hips together.

entries.name: Standing face to face
entries.description: Both standing pressed chest to chest, one thigh between the other's legs.

entries.name: One on the face, one on the hips
entries.description: One lies back; one partner straddles their face, another their hips.

entries.name: Standing circle
entries.description: Three or more standing in a tight ring, facing the centre.

entries.name: Two couples side by side
entries.description: Two pairs on one bed, close enough to touch the other pair.
